name: Wajiki (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Wajiki town emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised mountain with a small pointed base.
history: Flag of the former town of Wajiki in Tokushima Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-03-01. The municipal emblem was adopted in August 1970.

features.role: Wajiki town emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised mountain with a small pointed base
